questions.markdown:
Explain the use of following instruction.

i) RCR  ii) PUSHF  iii) DAS  iv) IMUL  v) JLS
Write a assembly language program to i) clear the screen ii) set cursor at the centre of the screen

If CS = 2000h, DS = 3000h, SS = 4000h, ES = 5000h, BX = 0030h

Determine the physical address for i) MOV CX, [BX]  ii) ADD AX, 20[BX]
Divide 11 by 3 using restoring division algorithm indicating all the steps.
Write an assembly language program to convert a 2-digit hexadecimal number available in the memory into BCD and store the result in the memory.
Write a procedure to set Trap Flag
Sketch the steps of Mode 2 operation of 8254.
Assume there is a class of people with following grades: 69,87,96, 45,75. Develop an assembly language program to find the highest grade
Present Big endian and Little endian method of byte addressing with examples.

questions.markdown: A half adder is a combinational logic circuit that has two inputs x and y. and two outputs, sum(s) and carry (c), resulting from the binary addition of x and y. Draw a half adder as a two level AND-OR circuit

questions.markdown: Given $M = 17_{10}$ and $Q = -16_{10}$, Perform multiplication using Booth's algorithm
Calculate average access time experienced by a processor, if a cache hit rate .88, miss penalty is 0.015 milliseconds and cache access time is 10 microseconds
Consider a memory consisting of 64K words of 8 bits each. Sketch the organization to implement this memory using 16K X 1 static memory chips.
Define the term cycle stealing and burst mode with respect to DMA
